events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && A="$(cat /tmp/t242c/admin-url)"; for s in webinar challenge rsp; do (PROFILE=242 node scripts/walk-ui.mjs "$A" $s > /tmp/t242c/walk-$s.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?" >> /tmp/t242c/walk-$s.log) & done; wait; for s in webinar challenge rsp; do echo "== $s"; tail -3 /tmp/t242c/walk-$s.log | cut -c1-300; python3 -c "import json;r=json.load(open('/tmp/walk/242-$s/report.json'));print('findings',len(r['findings']));[print(' ',f) for f in r['findings'][:12]];print('jobs',r.get('jobs'))" 2>&1 | cut -c1-400; done
